SELECT s.id, s.name, s.gender, s.phone, s.primary_relation AS primaryRelation, s.secondary_relation AS secondaryRelation, s.secondary_phone AS secondaryPhone, s.other_relation AS otherRelation, s.other_phone AS otherPhone, s.follow_status AS followStatus, s.card_no AS cardNo, s.face_status AS faceStatus, s.is_star AS isStar, s.status, s.campus_id AS campusId, s.campus_text AS campusText, c.name AS campusName, s.balance, s.debt, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(SUM( GREATEST(0, GREATEST(COALESCE(e.total_lessons, 0) * COALESCE(e.unit_price, 0), COALESCE(e.consumed_amount, 0)) - COALESCE(e.paid_amount, 0) ) / NULLIF(e.unit_price, 0) ), 1) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND e.status = '生效' ), 0) AS debtLessons, s.course_count AS courseCount, s.points, s.channel_name AS channelName, s.age_text AS ageText, s.grade, s.wechat, s.birthday, s.school, s.public_school_class AS publicSchoolClass, s.address, s.extra_info AS extraInfo, s.source, s.enroll_date AS enrollDate FROM student s JOIN campus c ON c.id = s.campus_id
ORDER BY CONVERT(s.name USING gbk) ASC, s.name ASC, s.id DESC ORDER BY CONVERT(s.name USING gbk) DESC, s.name DESC, s.id DESC ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(s.balance), 0) AS balance, COALESCE(SUM(s.debt), 0) AS debt, COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) AS points FROM student s

SELECT e.id, e.course_id AS courseId, e.class_id AS classId, co.name AS courseName, COALESCE(cg.name, fb.name) AS className, COALESCE(cg.teacher_text, st.name, fb.teacher_text, fst.name) AS teacher, COALESCE(cg.start_date, fb.start_date) AS startDate, e.created_at AS enrollTime, e.total_lessons AS totalLessons, e.gift_lessons AS giftLessons, e.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, e.used_lessons AS usedLessons, e.paid_amount AS paidAmount, e.consumed_amount AS consumedAmount, e.unit_price AS unitPrice, (CASE WHEN e.status = '结课' AND (e.paid_amount - e.consumed_amount) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE e.paid_amount - e.consumed_amount END) AS accountBalance, e.expire_date AS expireDate, e.status, e.remark, (SELECT MAX(dfp.paid_at) FROM data_fee_payment dfp WHERE dfp.enrollment_id = e.id) AS lastDataFeePaidAt FROM enrollment e JOIN course co ON co.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = e.class_id LEFT JOIN staff st ON st.id = cg.teacher_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cg2.id, cg2.name, cg2.teacher_text, cg2.teacher_id, cg2.start_date FROM class_student cs JOIN class_group cg2 ON cg2.id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = e.student_id AND cg2.course_id = e.course_id ORDER BY (cs.status = '在读') DESC, cs.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) fb ON TRUE LEFT JOIN staff fst ON fst.id = fb.teacher_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT channel_name FROM student WHERE channel_name IS NOT NULL AND channel_name <> '' ORDER BY channel_name
SELECT DISTINCT grade FROM student WHERE grade IS NOT NULL AND grade <> '' ORDER BY LENGTH(grade), grade
